open_points.subject: MultipartFileBody.read
open_points.text: MultipartFileBody.read: [BEHAVIOR] MUST answer the next bytes of the file part, at most size of them, size being passed positionally, reading stream only through stream.read and never answering a byte of delimiter or after it; it MUST hold, read and not yet answered, no more bytes than the delimiter's length, MUST call stream.read only while it holds fewer bytes than that, and each such call MUST ask for the delimiter's length less the bytes it holds, never for fewer, so that the file is read in pieces as long as the delimiter allows and not one byte at a time; it MUST answer empty bytes only once the delimiter has been reached, and on every later call.
open_points.question: For size equal to zero, returning at most size bytes requires empty bytes before the delimiter is reached, while the note forbids that; must size be restricted to positive integers, or must the empty-result rule permit non-positive size?

open_points.subject: read_upload_head
open_points.text: MUST read the head through stream.read alone
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted operation reference with prose referring to the stream port's declared read operation.

open_points.subject: read_upload_head
open_points.text: the boundary is the boundary parameter of content_type's multipart form data media type; the first part MUST be the form field the imported OWNER_CSRF_FIELD constant names, with no file name, whose value read as UTF-8 text is the CSRF value; the second part's headers MUST name a file by a filename parameter, an empty one included.

open_points.question: Move the fixed media-type, parameter, and encoding names to imported provider constants and name those constants in the note.

open_points.subject: read_upload_head
open_points.text: MUST answer an UploadHead holding the CSRF value, as delimiter a carriage return, a line feed, two hyphens and the boundary, and as file_declared_length declared_length less the bytes of the head it read and less those of the delimiter followed by two hyphens, a carriage return and a line feed, or None as file_declared_length when declared_length is None.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the inline delimiter micro-syntax with imported constants for the delimiter prefix and closing suffix, and refer to those constants by name.
